name_story.story: Omari can be understood through the Arabic form عُمَرِي, whose central sense is omari; flourishing; from umar (swahili form). Omari is the Swahili form of Arabic عُمَرِي, the relative form of عُمَر (ʿUmar).

faq.a: Omari is associated with the Arabic form عُمَرِي, whose core sense is omari; flourishing; from umar (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Omari?
faq.a: Omari is associated with Arabic. Omari is the Swahili form of Arabic عُمَرِي, the relative form of عُمَر (ʿUmar).
Yes — the underlying form عُمَرِي is Arabic.
Omari can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Omari should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUmar is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Omari mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Omari is rendered عمری and carries the sense عمری، عمر سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Omari mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Omari is rendered عمری and carries the sense عمری، منسوب به عمر.
A romanized syllable approximation is o-ma-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Omari?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Omari, omari. Script forms are عمري, عمری, عُمَرِي, उमरी.

faq.q: Is Omari a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
